remarks: Beautiful 3 family home in the Harbor Point area. The owner occupies the largest unit 1 which is 2330 sq.ft plus the finished lower level. That unit has a nice living room and dining room. There is a large eat in kitchen with white cabinets and ss appliances, a pantry and a closet along with a mud room and door to the deck. Plus there is a full bath on the main level. There are 3 bedrooms on the second floor and 2 full baths. The master suite has a walk in closet and an updated bath with double sinks and granite counters . There are two other bedrooms and a full bath. The lower level is finished with 4 rooms and a bath. So there are 4 bathrooms in unit 1. Unit 2 has Living room eat in kitchen with a pantry, bath with a white pedestal sink and tub and a bedroom. Unit 3 has living room , large kitchen, bath and 2 bedrooms. There is a lovely landscaped yard, shed, deck and patio.
